page.title: Drivers
page.description: Official ISL roster: teams, drivers, and profiles - updated as the season progresses.

grid.historicalDescription: Drivers who competed in previous ISL seasons.

modal.raceEventsTooltip: Total number of events the driver was entered in (Regular Races + 25% Races + Sprint Races combined). An event counts here even if the driver qualified but did not start the race (DNS).

rankExplanation.allTime: The number shows the driver's rank in this stat among all-time drivers.
rankExplanation.season: The number shows the driver's rank in this stat among active drivers this season.
rankExplanation.compAllTime: The number shows the driver's rank in this stat among {scope} league drivers, all-time.
rankExplanation.compSeason: The number shows the driver's rank in this stat among {scope} league drivers this season.

ratingTooltips.rating_consistency: Ability to deliver stable results and avoid DNFs/major swings.
ratingTooltips.rating_agility: Ability in rain/changing conditions and adapting during races.
ratingTooltips.rating_overall: Weighted overall rating combining all categories.
